title: Map-Specific Procedural World Proposal Workbench over PCA
objective: Implement one map-specific procedural world proposal workbench over PCA-owned recipe/seed/cache execution, with independently previewable, regenerable, rejectable and owner-promotable proposal packs for geography/elevation; hydrology/climate/biome/resources; and population/settlement/culture/state/routes/trade, without taking generic PCA generation authority or canonical owner-domain mutation authority.

scope.purpose: Provide one map-specific procedural proposal workbench over the PCA recipe/seed/cache substrate while retaining generic generation execution in PCA and keeping owner promotion explicit.
included: hydrology, climate, biome and resource proposal pack
population, settlement, culture, state, route and trade proposal pack
independent preview, regeneration, rejection and owner-promotion receipts over PCA substrate
scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS maps can deterministically configure and inspect map-specific PCA-backed proposal packs, preserve independent preview/regeneration/rejection/promotion boundaries, and leave generic generation execution and canonical owner mutation outside MCS authority.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MCS-10 publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order; MCS-13 is next selected.
MCS-10 absorbed baseline MCS-11 and MCS-12 into one map-facing procedural proposal workbench over the shared PCA recipe/seed/cache/spatial/simulation substrate.

PCA-02 retained graph/recipe/seed/cache authority, PCA-03 retained spatial candidate-generation authority, and PCA-12 retained generic simulation/feasibility authority; MCS-10 consumed their receipts without rebuilding those engines.

Geography/elevation, hydrology/climate/biome/resources, and population/settlement/culture/state/routes/trade remained independently previewable, regenerable, rejectable and owner-promotable proposal packs; owner promotion remained explicit and non-mutating.

Concurrent owner-authorized UISK-13 and UISK-14 publications advanced application main while MCS-10 was active. Each stale validation base was rejected; the unchanged six-file MCS-10 delta was reconciled onto fresh main and fully revalidated before publication.
MCS-13, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work were not started by this execution.
next_action: MCS-10 is closed. MCS-13 is selected_not_started; wait for a later owner Continue before granting MCS-13 implementation authority.
